pairs.summary: HES5 and Nrf1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 3 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer). Median lift 1.44x, typical spacing ~50 bp between sites. In 2 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.

ETV2::FIGLA and HES5 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 5 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Fibroblast (Liver Adrenal); ...). Median lift 1.56x, typical spacing ~69 bp between sites. In 2 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif, overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
